in_marathi.name: Sharvi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvi is a Hindu girl name which means 'Goddess of Fortune'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shri', which is a name of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth and prosperity.
